title: $SA is DOWN -28% today, to $18.40.
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
The spark: a B.C. court confirmed the permit protection on Seabridge's flagship KSM gold-copper project stays quashed, and it now needs open-ended "deep consultation" with a local First Nation. Gold sliding to a 14-month low isn't helping either.  
  
  
Yesterday (Wed, Nov 18) it closed at $25.55. Today (Thu, Nov 19) it gapped down to a fresh 52-week low and is trading around $18.40.
